name: Immich Remote ML
description: Standalone native Immich machine-learning service for facial recognition and smart search. Uses AMD ROCm when an AMD GPU is passed through to the LXC, with a CPU fallback.
notes: In Immich, set the Machine Learning URL to http://<LXC-IP>:3003. The API has no authentication; restrict TCP port 3003 to the Immich server and trusted LAN.
ROCm requires AMD GPU passthrough and a compatible Proxmox host driver. For unsupported gfx1030 devices, set HSA_OVERRIDE_GFX_VERSION=10.3.0 in /etc/default/immich-remote-ml.
ROCm libraries and model caches require substantial disk space; the default LXC disk is 50 GiB. CPU backend is selected when no AMD GPU is detected.
